paragraphs.text: Nanchang Changbei International Airport (KHN/ZSCN) serves as a key air gateway for Nanchang, CN, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 03/21: 3400 m (11155 ft) concrete.
Ground transportation options connecting Nanchang Changbei International Airport with central Nanchang include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from KHN should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Nanchang Changbei International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Nanchang Changbei International Airport is KHN and the ICAO code is ZSCN.

faqs.q: Which city does KHN airport serve?
faqs.a: Nanchang Changbei International Airport (KHN) serves Nanchang, CN.
